entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Every spring, the seaside town of S..."
entries.dialogueText: Every spring, the seaside town of Sallabes celebrated the Scarlet Kingbird Festival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The vibrantly colored songbirds spe..."
entries.dialogueText: The vibrantly colored songbirds spent their winters in Xina, near the southern part of what used to be the Mousser Empire. Every spring, like clockwork, they flew back over the Gulf of Moridia to settle in Sallabes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their return was celebrated with mu..."
entries.dialogueText: Their return was celebrated with music, dancing and lavish banquets, opened by a speech from the reigning Count or Countess of Sallabes. It was traditional for the King of Rizia and his family to attend.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Greetings, Sallabeans!""
entries.dialogueText: "Greetings, Sallabeans!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun hung low in the sky over th..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun hung low in the sky over the Arena Sallabes, a hundred-year-old open-air venue perched directly on the beach. Vina and I sat waiting in the royal box as cameras flashed in our direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter impatiently tapped her..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter impatiently tapped her fingers on the arm of her chair. We hadn't spoken much since Iza.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise I won't try to shoot any..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise I won't try to shoot any of the birds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. It'll start soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. It'll start soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sit still. Can't you see everyone'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sit still. Can't you see everyone's watching?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you corresponding with Rico th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you corresponding with Rico these days?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed bleakly."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed bleakly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience roared as Manus Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience roared as Manus Sazon got onstage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He waited for the applause to subsi..."
entries.dialogueText: He waited for the applause to subside, then held up a hand for the audience to listen. The entire arena fell silent.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The story of the scarlet kingbird..."
entries.dialogueText: "The story of the scarlet kingbird is a story about trust."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""He doesn't know what perils await..."
entries.dialogueText: "He doesn't know what perils await him on the way to his destination, nor what sort of welcome will await him there. Yet he flies on, because something deep within his soul compels him to do so."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Every year, this tiny feathered cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every year, this tiny feathered creature travels thousands of kilometers to reach our shores."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And what of those who wait for him..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what of those who wait for him? They have no idea where he's been, or how he knows to navigate to this exact same spot each time. Still they gather here, scanning the skies for the first sign of his return."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""An inner voice that tells him, 'Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "An inner voice that tells him, 'This is your home.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is he talking about himself?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is he talking about himself?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish he'd get to the point.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish he'd get to the point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is so maudlin. Why is the cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is so maudlin. Why is the crowd eating it up?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Huh. The kid has charisma.""
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. The kid has charisma."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Shh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shh."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina glared at me, then turned her..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina glared at me, then turned her full attention back to the man on stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As if on cue, a solitary bird came..."
entries.dialogueText: As if on cue, a solitary bird came flying towards us from over the horizon. Its plumage was bright red.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A tear rolled down Manus' cheek."
entries.dialogueText: A tear rolled down Manus' cheek.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Trust. It's the only way any of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust. It's the only way any of this works. Even when we've been given no reason. Even when our faith is tested, over and over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A second bird followed, then a thir..."
entries.dialogueText: A second bird followed, then a third.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A little bit. He says Bruno's runn..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little bit. He says Bruno's running almost as fast on three legs as he did on four."

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sorry. Just excited to see the bir..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. Just excited to see the birds."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's only when we place our trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's only when we place our trust in one another that we are able to find our way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience gasped as the sky over..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience gasped as the sky over our heads filled with hundreds and hundreds of kingbirds, their crimson feathers magnificently lit by the setting sun.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Keep your head down, Vina. Too muc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep your head down, Vina. Too much trust will get you a face full of shit."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't be so crass, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so crass, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sniffled. She had tears in her..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sniffled. She had tears in her eyes as well.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you ever seen anything so bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you ever seen anything so beautiful?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's breathtaking.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's breathtaking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Timing the speech perfectly with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Timing the speech perfectly with the migration? What a cheap trick."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't see anything cheap about i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see anything cheap about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once the sun had set and the birds..."
entries.dialogueText: Once the sun had set and the birds had gone to roost, we made our way to the VIP reception in the neighboring pavilion.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A simple message. But you can't de..."
entries.dialogueText: "A simple message. But you can't deny the truth in it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I thought it was beautiful.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought it was beautiful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A big band was playing jazz music a..."
entries.dialogueText: A big band was playing jazz music as Vina and I entered. We immediately found ourselves surrounded by local officials, celebrities and members of the press.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was nearly an hour before I was..."
entries.dialogueText: It was nearly an hour before I was able to sit down. Almost as soon as I parked myself in a chair, I noticed Manus Sazon making his way over to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon. A pleasure to see you a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon. A pleasure to see you again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was some speech today. I see..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was some speech today. I see why your constituents love you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not in the mood to dance, Mr. Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not in the mood to dance, Mr. Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus smiled and shook my hand."
entries.dialogueText: Manus smiled and shook my hand.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A relief to hear, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "A relief to hear, Your Majesty. I wasn't sure what to think after our last meeting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus smiled and bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: Manus smiled and bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The birds did most of the heavy li..."
entries.dialogueText: "The birds did most of the heavy lifting. But thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Rico wrote me that Bruno is back o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico wrote me that Bruno is back on his feet. Well, three of them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pointed to a cluster of buildin..."
entries.dialogueText: She pointed to a cluster of buildings a little further down the coastline. In the middle of it rose a spire covered in scaffolding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus smiled uncomfortably."
entries.dialogueText: Manus smiled uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm better off on the debate floor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm better off on the debate floor than the dance floor, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Actually, I've been hoping to spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, I've been hoping to speak with you for a long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That seat is reserved for my daugh..."
entries.dialogueText: "That seat is reserved for my daughter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gestured across the room. Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gestured across the room. Vina was standing by the bar, having an animated conversation with the Derdian bartender.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With your permission, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "With your permission, Your Majesty, I'd like to keep it warm for a moment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a measured sip from the win..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a measured sip from the wine glass he was holding.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But I still think we have a chance..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I still think we have a chance to accomplish great things for this country."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As I said, I am not my father. Ano..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, I am not my father. Another revolution would damage the country and endanger what's left of my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why? What exactly is it that you w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? What exactly is it that you want?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You assumed wrong. I don't intend..."
entries.dialogueText: "You assumed wrong. I don't intend to give up a single one of my powers as king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you are telling me you have abs..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you are telling me you have absolutely no intention of doing away with the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure you're aware that removin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you're aware that removing any of the nobility's privileges would invite the wrath of all three royal houses. Yours included."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus shook his head hurriedly."
entries.dialogueText: Manus shook his head hurriedly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I apologize for the misunderstandi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I apologize for the misunderstanding."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I was just speaking to the bartend..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just speaking to the bartender. He's still trying to get the rest of his family out of Derdia. I told him I'd see what I could do."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's very noble of you. But ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very noble of you. But there are thousands like him, and not all of them are lucky enough to catch the Princess of Rizia at a benevolent moment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to Manus.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Your speech was beautiful, Mr. Saz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your speech was beautiful, Mr. Sazon. Actually, it reminded me of an essay of Queen Lyza's from 1883--"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What were the others?""
entries.dialogueText: "What were the others?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""'On Social Contracts.' Yes, that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "'On Social Contracts.' Yes, that was one inspiration."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Really? I'd love to hear more abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? I'd love to hear more about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The band began playing "Sweetheart..."
entries.dialogueText: The band began playing "Sweetheart of Ventrie City", an upbeat tune that had recently reached us from Arcasia.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You know what? I'll tell you after..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what? I'll tell you after this dance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The band began playing "Sweetheart..."
entries.dialogueText: The band began playing "Sweetheart of Ventrie City," an upbeat tune that had recently reached us from Arcasia.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You know what? Tell me after this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what? Tell me after this dance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a step closer towards Manu..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a step closer towards Manus and extended a hand to him. He looked at me questioningly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Wait, this is faster than the danc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait, this is faster than the dances I've been learning. Do you know the steps?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As a matter of fact, I do. I'll wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I do. I'll walk you through it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If he did, Vina didn't notice. Came..."
entries.dialogueText: If he did, Vina didn't notice. Cameras flashed as the two of them started dancing.

entries.title: Narrator: "It was the same one her mother had..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the same one her mother had given me during our first dance together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In all the years I'd been with Lena..."
entries.dialogueText: In all the years I'd been with Lena, my wife had never looked at me that way.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They are, and I wish I had time to..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are, and I wish I had time to act on them. But there are international crises that require my full attention."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The kind of reforms I'm suggesting..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kind of reforms I'm suggesting can keep Rizia stable through such crises."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Just know that should you choose t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just know that should you choose to guide Rizia in a more democratic direction, my party is prepared to back you."

entries.dialogueText: "Oh, what's that over there?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It looks Dastnurist. I wonder if t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It looks Dastnurist. I wonder if that's the sanctuary the Grand Wiseman was asking for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. I thought it would be smaller.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. I thought it would be smaller."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a big, expensive building for..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a big, expensive building for heretics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered my orders to fund the..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered my orders to fund the construction of an expanded Dastnurist Grandsanctuary in Sallabes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That ought to keep the Wehzeks out..."
entries.dialogueText: "That ought to keep the Wehzeks out of trouble for a while."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sal was right. Everyone deserves a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sal was right. Everyone deserves a space to worship God in their own way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope it has good security.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope it has good security."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He led Vina out onto the dance floo..."
entries.dialogueText: He led Vina out onto the dance floor. I could swear he had the faintest hint of a smirk on his face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He led Vina out onto the dance floo..."
entries.dialogueText: He led Vina out onto the dance floor. Cameras flashed as the two of them started dancing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if the photographers wer..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if the photographers were capturing the look in my daughter's eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This was no longer the nervous youn..."
entries.dialogueText: This was no longer the nervous young man I'd met in Porte Drazon. He radiated confidence as he stepped up to the podium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry I haven't visited the Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry I haven't visited the House of Delegates yet. It's been a busy time."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand, Your Majesty. The Zi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Your Majesty. The Zille incident rattled us all. My family included."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To be perfectly honest... I've bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be perfectly honest... I've been avoiding you. Too much bad blood."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand. But isn't that preci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. But isn't that precisely *why* we should talk?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus smiled warmly."
entries.dialogueText: Manus smiled warmly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not address my daughter with su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not address my daughter with such impudence, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's right. We've got to tackle th..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's right. We've got to tackle this problem at the root, not by granting special favors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How drunk are you, Vina? You can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "How drunk are you, Vina? You can't go around making promises to random cater-waiters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forgive me, Mr. Sazon, but the Pri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Mr. Sazon, but the Princess and I have really got to be going."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina ignored my remark."
entries.dialogueText: Vina ignored my remark.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina rolled her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Vina rolled her eyes.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He was speaking to me as an equal,..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was speaking to me as an equal, Father. I welcome his opinions."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Over my dead body.""
entries.dialogueText: "Over my dead body."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need my permission. Have..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need my permission. Have fun out there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do apologize, Mr. Sazon. It's be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do apologize, Mr. Sazon. It's been lovely to spend time in your family's province."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Until next time, Your Highness. Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So why didn't you request an audie..."
entries.dialogueText: "So why didn't you request an audience with me?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a look that was equal pa..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a look that was equal parts hurt and puzzled.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I did, through your Grand Vizier...."
entries.dialogueText: "I did, through your Grand Vizier. The message must have gotten lost."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Please, Your Majesty. Just give me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. Just give me five minutes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But since we're both here right no..."
entries.dialogueText: "But since we're both here right now, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who's speaking to me right now? Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who's speaking to me right now? The heir of House Sazon or the speaker of the Rizian People's Party?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right, I'll indulge you. Tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, I'll indulge you. Tell me what you have in mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have some nerve even approachi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have some nerve even approaching me after what your father did."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I don't expect you to forgive Luca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't expect you to forgive Lucas Sazon. I haven't forgiven him myself."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I used to hate him for robbing me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I used to hate him for robbing me of my birthright. Now, I realize his real crime was robbing Rizia of the peaceful transition it deserved."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The two cannot be separated.""
entries.dialogueText: "The two cannot be separated."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I joined the House of Delegates be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I joined the House of Delegates because of Lucas Sazon. Because my father's rash act of violence robbed Rizia of the peaceful transition it deserved."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Well, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The rest of the RPP and I are in a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rest of the RPP and I are in agreement. Our kingdom thirsts for reform. We can grant our people a voice without spilling a drop of blood."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You mentioned a transition. But a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mentioned a transition. But a transition to what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The kind of change you're talking..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kind of change you're talking about doesn't happen peacefully. Look at how many corpses the Century of Revolutions left in its wake."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It didn't have to be that way. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "It didn't have to be that way. If the kings and queens of your father's generation had been willing to compromise, they might have kept their crowns."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Quite right, Your Majesty. With ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite right, Your Majesty. With just a few changes, it can fulfill its intended purpose."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus traced the rim of his wine gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus traced the rim of his wine glass with his finger.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I heard your coronation speech. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard your coronation speech. I believe your aims are the same as mine."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I don't want to make assumptions....."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to make assumptions... But could it be that your aims are the same as mine?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I envision a Rizia where the conce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I envision a Rizia where the concerns of commoners and nobles are given equal weight. Where an elected parliament makes the laws, but the royals retain their status and influence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why? The people of Rizia have ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? The people of Rizia have everything they want. And if they want more, I'll give them more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you trying to threaten me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you trying to threaten me?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""There are factions within Rizia th..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are factions within Rizia that have other, more radical ideas. The RPP and I are keeping them in check. For now."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know what you and your family th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you and your family think of me. And I know that my position in government is symbolic at best."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And House Sazon? What do your rela..."
entries.dialogueText: "And House Sazon? What do your relatives think of your crusade against their kind?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus traced the rim of his wine gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus traced the rim of his wine glass with his finger.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""My crusade is not against the nobi..."
entries.dialogueText: "My crusade is not against the nobility, Your Majesty. It's on behalf of all Rizians."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's why any reforms we implemen..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why any reforms we implemented would have to proceed very gradually."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I would never presume to tell the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never presume to tell the King how the country should be run."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Certainly not, Your Majesty. Prese..."
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly not, Your Majesty. Preserving the status of the Rizian nobility is as much in my family's interest as it is yours."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""They want to be heard, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "They want to be heard, Your Majesty. Not placated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A second uprising will not happen..."
entries.dialogueText: "A second uprising will not happen during my reign."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The commoners are tired of a rulin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The commoners are tired of a ruling class that places its own desires above their own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How exactly would you back me?""
entries.dialogueText: "How exactly would you back me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'For now'. Is that supposed to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "'For now'. Is that supposed to be a threat?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not your job to keep them in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not your job to keep them in check. It's mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's the right idea. Without an..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the right idea. Without an outlet for their demands, they could become dangerous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hypothetically, if I, the King of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hypothetically, if I, the King of Rizia, asked you to assist me in the complete dismantling of the monarchy, would you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I don't?""
entries.dialogueText: "And if I don't?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am more interested in knowing th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am more interested in knowing that House Sazon won't rise against me again."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know I am taking a risk by sugge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know I am taking a risk by suggesting this to you. But I believe that unless significant changes are made, we may face another uprising."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I do not doubt the strength of you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt the strength of your regime, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But the commoners are tired of a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the commoners are tired of a ruling class that places its own desires above their own."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But the longer our people are sile..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the longer our people are silenced, the louder they will be when they finally speak."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We will not go against you.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will not go against you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like what you're implying...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like what you're implying. I would advise you to choose your next words very carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What in the hell do you mean by th..."
entries.dialogueText: "What in the hell do you mean by that? I have only ever had my people's needs at heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am looking forward to working mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am looking forward to working more closely with your party to better serve our people. But changing the entire system of government? We probably won't go that far."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""My house has learned its lesson, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "My house has learned its lesson, Your Majesty. As long as you treat its members with dignity, they will be among your most loyal supporters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with the idea of reforming..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with the idea of reforming Rizia and empowering our legislative body. It is my wish that we work together to make it a reality."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus' eyes lit up. He smiled confi..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus' eyes lit up. He smiled confidently.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We can discuss this back in the ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can discuss this back in the capital, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""No, Your Majesty. The opposite.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. The opposite."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, of course. But, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course. But, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate the risk you took in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the risk you took in coming to me. It can't have been easy."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you for hearing me out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for hearing me out."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We will get the public on your sid..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will get the public on your side. When the time comes, they will embrace reform without hesitation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should end this conversation be..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should end this conversation before I'm obliged to have you arrested for treason."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Well, I...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a handkerchief out of his p..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a handkerchief out of his pocket and dabbed his brow.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I obviously chose the wrong venue..."
entries.dialogueText: "I obviously chose the wrong venue for this conversation."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a handkerchief out of his p..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a handkerchief out of his pocket and dabbed his brow.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Please forget I brought this up wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please forget I brought this up with you, then.."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is no right venue. You shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no right venue. You shouldn't have bothered me in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, please go on. What were you go..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, please go on. What were you going to tell me?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Of course. But will your successor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. But will your successor? Or your successor's successor? We've seen how risky it is to let the fate of the country rest on a single ruler."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My house was chosen by God to rule..."
entries.dialogueText: "My house was chosen by God to rule, Mr. Sazon. Are you saying God made a mistake?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Gladly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not forget.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will not forget."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's nothing personal. But conside..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's nothing personal. But consider this topic off-limits."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""No, absolutely. I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, absolutely. I understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood up and pushed back his cha..."
entries.dialogueText: He stood up and pushed back his chair.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If you'll excuse me, Your Majesty,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, Your Majesty, I'm going to refresh my drink."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around to head to the bar..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around to head to the bar and came face to face with Vina, who was returning to our table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face was slightly flushed."
entries.dialogueText: Her face was slightly flushed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh, excuse me, Mr. Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, excuse me, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Nothing to excuse, Your Highness...."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing to excuse, Your Highness. I hope you're enjoying your time in Sallabes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Nothing...""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Right, yes. Forgive me...""
entries.dialogueText: "Right, yes. Forgive me..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I-- okay. Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- okay. Understood."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you. I won't trouble you aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I won't trouble you again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't try to disguise your power g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't try to disguise your power grab as altruism, Mr. Sazon. I can see right through you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see your point.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see your point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you implying about my dau..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you implying about my daughter, Mr. Sazon? You believe she's unfit to rule?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A tentative smile appeared on Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: A tentative smile appeared on Manus' face.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Come to the House of Delegates. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come to the House of Delegates. You should have an idea how the current system works before we begin talking about how to fix it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I suppose your solution to tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I suppose your solution to that would be to make yourself Prime Minister?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I promise you, this is not about w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise you, this is not about what I want. It's about securing the stability of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree that my government could b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that my government could be doing more for the non-noble classes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand, Your Majesty. Of cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Your Majesty. Of course my party would be thrilled to have your ear."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It would be an honor to see you at..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be an honor to see you at the next House of Delegates session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll be there.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll see what I can do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see what I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't get too excited. I'm not pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get too excited. I'm not promising anything yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a smile, he stood up and pushe..."
entries.dialogueText: With a smile, he stood up and pushed back his chair.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I've taken up enough of your time...."
entries.dialogueText: "I've taken up enough of your time. If you'll excuse me, I'll freshen up my drink."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's not...""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand what you're saying. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand what you're saying. But now is not the right time to start changing the status quo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A disappointed look spread across h..."
entries.dialogueText: A disappointed look spread across his face.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If not now, then when, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "If not now, then when, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't push me, boy. I've given you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't push me, boy. I've given you enough of my time this evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If and when the Zille crisis is so..."
entries.dialogueText: "If and when the Zille crisis is solved, we may be able to revisit the topic."

entries.title: Narrator: "A fanfare sounded from the pit orch..."
entries.dialogueText: A fanfare sounded from the pit orchestra, and a dark-haired woman stepped on stage. I recognized her as Leona Sazon, Countess of Sallabes.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Ladies and gentlemen!""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen!"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It is my great pleasure to welcome..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my great pleasure to welcome His Majesty King Romus and Her Highness Princess Vina to our humble city."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""We have another special guest here..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have another special guest here today as well."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""It has been 25 years since my belo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been 25 years since my beloved cousin Angelica was sent into exile. Like all Sazons, I hold out hope that someday, the King in his infinite generosity will bring her back to us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. Perhaps the Sazon matriarch h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. Perhaps the Sazon matriarch has been punished for long enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ha. Nice try, Leona.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. Nice try, Leona."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only way Angelica is returning..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only way Angelica is returning to Rizia is in a coffin."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina ignored me. She craned her nec..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina ignored me. She craned her neck to get a better view of the stage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm bored already. When do we eat?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm bored already. When do we eat?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina nodded. She craned her neck to..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina nodded. She craned her neck to get a better view of the stage.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Today, we are graced with the pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we are graced with the presence of her child Manus. Heir of House Sazon, leader of the Rizian People's Party and prodigal son of Brenas."
